notes.title: Console release for We Were Here Forever!
notes.notes:
Dear Explorers,

We want to wish you all a happy new year!

We’re starting off this year with a bang as [i]We Were Here Forever[/i]is now on console with cross-play support! Check out the new trailer.

[previewyoutube=fbG8YCcnRqI;full][/previewyoutube]
Cross-play means that you can play with anyone; it doesn’t matter what platform they’re playing on (PC or console). To get you started on your new adventure in Castle Rock with your fellow Explorer, [i] We Were Here Forever[/i] is now on sale with a [b]20% discount[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever/

[h2]Ask us Anything[/h2]

In celebration of [i]We Were Here Forever[/i]’s console release, an AMA on the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/PS5/]PS5 Reddit[/url] on [b]February 1st at 3pm CET/6am PST/ 8AM CST/ 11PM JST[/b] will be happening! Had any questions about the game (series) that you’ve been dying to get an answer for, or just want to ask what our favourite food is? This is your time to ask us! We’re going to give away some extras too. Hope to see you there! 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/48bb22a943dc6cbc740de473e88d148e8417aa6f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/48bb22a943dc6cbc740de473e88d148e8417aa6f.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: New Release Trailer for We Were Here Forever!
notes.notes:
Hello explorers,

The launch of [i]We Were Here Forever[/i] is almost here! On[b] May 10th[/b], you'll be challenged to escape Castle Rock once more along side your partner! Curious to see some in-game places you'll have to explore? We share some in our new release trailer !

[previewyoutube=3085f9umxlQ;full][/previewyoutube]

This is our biggest game yet with over 12 hours of gameplay! Or if you're [i]simply not that clever[/i], it might take you a little bit longer...

[h2][i]We Were Here[/i] live-action series[/h2]
Furthermore, don't forget about our live-action series 'Chronicles of Castle Rock'! Stories of Kees Klokkenmaker are told. Listen and see how he experienced certain events regarding Castle Rock, the king,  the Keep and more! 

[previewyoutube=uDLTAtPBTXs;full][/previewyoutube]

Be sure to wishlist the game if you haven't already. It will notify you when the game is available for you to purchase!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever/

[i][h3]See you in 5 days! [/h3][/i]

[b]Total Mayhem Games[/b]

notes.title: Signal detected! New update released!
notes.notes:
[h1]Setting new frequencies[/h1]
As you may have noticed, we have updated We Were Here on Steam! This patch implements a new voice-chat system called Vivox. This should improve communication between explorers using their walkie-talkies, especially those trapped in Castle Rock!
You also might notice that when booting up We Were Here Too, the main menu has received a bit of a facelift! Not only is it looking better, it will also keep you up to date with what’s going on with the We Were Here Series… speaking of which… 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/cd02464d9fc598b8de38a48e07959448b39e4021.jpg[/img]
[h2]Wear it like you mean it[/h2]
We have opened up our brand new merchandise store! There is an even better way to explore Castle Rock when you look the part with your co-op partner! There are different lines of designs, like our simple yet straightforward [b]TMG Essentials[/b] designs. Our [b]TMG FOR FRIENDS[/b] is there for those who want to relive those memories of being trapped and spending a lot of valuable time together. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/5c7a2d1342c730cc769b100bed398427537c3a0f.png[/img]
But there is [b]limited[/b] merchandise as well! Such as [b]Curse of Castle Rock[/b] pieces of merch as well as [b]Holiday[/b]-related sweaters to keep you and your co-op partner warm!  These lines of merchandise are available until January 31st! 

Can’t wait to get your own merch? Go to http://www.totalmayhemmerch.com
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/773fbc1acfbc56f922c97fbd755a3c7efa2a8238.png[/img]
[h2]Ho Ho Hold on![/h2]
The explorers sure like to celebrate whenever there is a good occasion to do so! If you explore the basecamp in [b]We Were Here Together[/b], you might find them eating some treats based on a Dutch tradition called ‘Sinterklaas’. Can you find all of them? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/8d25191f160e039e2486f4ae5607053ca9484050.gif[/img]
There’s also a door on the basecamp that’s yet to be opened… I wonder if there’s something lurking behind that as well… 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/8c5368d9173a8a79f0b172e05c13a014fcf0929a.png[/img]
That’s all for now, over and out!

notes.title: June News Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Good things are on the way...[/h3]
Thanks to everyone who filled out the [i]We Were Here[/i] series survey earlier this year! We've been poring over the results, and there's some fascinating stuff and great feedback. 

The results from the [i]We Were Here[/i] survey have been very informative - there's a lot of solid feedback there. Feedback that we can take in for our next project. We're really looking forward to sharing stuff with you as soon as we can! 
Thanks again to everyone who took the time to fill it out! It really helps us define our path to next development chapter.. more on that in due course. Also a shout out to the brave 193 people (20% of respondents) who said that 'jump scares' are what they enjoy most in puzzles :D

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/e3d819d885caf8bd8363ccfeee0828dd95824a68.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/e3d819d885caf8bd8363ccfeee0828dd95824a68.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Check out this great fan art by player Fenris![/i]


[h3]We Were Here Together now also on Xbox One![/h3]
We just released [i]We Were Here Together[/i] for Xbox One, and we're already busy on more exciting things...

To celebrate the release, [i]We Were Here Too[/i] is currently 50% off here on Steam! If you or a friend don't own the game yet, now's the time :)

That's all the news for now. Before signing off, we wanted to share this [b]interestingly edited[/b] image by player Ensh'eass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/3b012dec515c50c5eb0ceb7d425bd0e5402159da.jpg[/img]
[h1]Cheers![/h1][h2]Total Mayhem Team[/h2]

notes.title: Game Update 1.1.5
notes.notes:
We have released an update for [i]We Were Here Too![/i] 
Version 1.1.5 contains the following:

[h2]Upgrades[/h2]
Performance improvements.
Reduced loading times.
Voice chat stability.
New first person camera rig.
Updated the splashscreen.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
Fixed several start up crashes.
Fixed multiple weapon bug in weapons puzzle.
Fixed an issue where progression was not saved.
Fixed an issue with achievements not unlocking.
Fixed an issue where both players would spawn as Lord.
Arms no longer flicker when crouching.

[b]Don't forget that we're also running a survey for only about 24 hours more, and you could win merch! [/b][url=https://forms.gle/Pda7AMnvieXKdb1v7]Take the survey![/url]

notes.title: We Were Here Too - Patch V.25022018
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Since some people are having issues starting the game we have decided to initialize our systems in stages.

During the Splashscreen you will be able to track the progress of systems being initialized. If you experience any issues during this process please let us know so we look for any issues in the specified system.

Gameplay related issues will be addressed in a future patch.

Thanks again for all of your feedback.

notes.title: We Were Here Too - Patch V.21022018
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I've got some new patch notes for you here, this also includes the issues we have fixed in the hotfix from last week.

[h1]Patch notes V.21022018– February 21th 2018[/h1]

[b][General][/b]
[list]
[*]We have changed some of our start up parameters to avoid resolution issues.
[*]Added the possibilty to rebind the movement keys (keyboard only).
[*]Updated some more names in the credits.
[*]Fixed save game related crashes.
[/list]

[b][Gamepad][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some issues while navigating the menus with a gamepad.
[*]The pawn on the battleboard no longer loses focus after completing a stage.
[*]Gamepad rebinding should now work as intended. (Revert to default will show the buttons again).
[/list]

[b][Ending][/b]
[list]
[*]Dying and respawning with all secret levers pulled will now work correctly.
[/list]

[b][Save Game][/b]
[list]
[*]Moved the Config.cfg to a public folder to avoid permission issues.
[/list]

The file can now be found in the following location.
[b]Windows: [/b]%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Total Mayhem Games\We Were Here Too\Config
[b]OSX: [/b]~/Library/Application Support/Total Mayhem Games/We Were Here Too/Config
[b]Linux: [/b]$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/unity3d/Total Mayhem Games/We Were Here Too/Config
Expect the old folder/file to be removed in a future update.

[b]Video Issue[/b]
We've been trying to reproduce the issue on our systems without luck, however we have made some changes to the code based on the videos and reports we have collected on the forums. Please let us know if the issue has been resolved.

If you are still experiencing any issues i encourage you to join the discussions here on steam!

Thanks again for all of your feedback.

notes.title: We Were Here Too - Patch V.09022018
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Let me start off with thanking you guys for hunting down and reporting some issues you may have encountered! Let's take a look at what today's patch has in store for our explorers.

[h1]Patch notes V.09022018 – February 9th 2018[/h1]

[b][The Stairwell][/b][list]
[*]Fixed an issue with occlusion culling when standing in certain spots
[*]Rebalanced the amount of time remaining on a wrong solution
[/list]

[b][The Arena][/b][list]
[*]Rebalanced the time available between some of the objectives
[/list]

[b][The Elevator][/b][list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the rotating wheel when a controller was plugged in
[/list]

[b][General][/b][list]
[*]Fixed alot of minor things that would make this list [i]too[/i] big!
[*]Players can now select a region to connect with. 
     [i]Please look for the dropdown menu in the top-right when searching or creating a new game and select the region with the best ping for you[/i]
[*]Increased the spacing between the lobbies when searching for a game
[*]Restarting from a checkpoint after a game over should now synchronize properly between players
[*]Resolved an issue with voice chat on the game over screen
[*]Improved voice chat
     [i]We managed to crack some bugs and issues, thanks for reporting them![/i]
[*]Improved readability of the text on some of the books found around the game
[*]Added some missing names to the credits
     [i]Sorry![/i]
[/list]

We'll keep on improving our user experience with patches. Thanks again for all of your feedback and we hope you enjoy your time cooperating!

Hi everyone!

Today is a special day - and we'd like to start off with a personal message to you. This game has been the product of hours and hours of hard work, and we could not be more proud. We hope you’ll forgive us for the delays, but we promise it will all be worth it.

That’s why, from today on, you’ll be able to pre-order We Were Here Too! The pre-order is available on our [url=http://totalmayhemgames.com/preorder/]website[/url] and works with HumbleBundle!

By pre-ordering We Were Here Too you’ll also be guaranteed access to the closed beta sometime in January!

To celebrate We Were Here Too being this close to launching, we made two awesome videos to show a glimpse of what awaits you. notes.title: Update regarding release date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

As many of you know we had set the planned release date for We Were Here Too this summer. With the end of summer drawing near we have decided to delay our planned release for We Were Here Too and its’ first chapter. We are now aiming for a release this November with closed beta tests finishing in October.

We feel this delay is necessary to provide everyone with an unforgettable experience that is above and beyond what the original game offered!

So sit tight for a little longer. We hope you’ll understand and be sure to add We Were Here Too to your wishlist if you haven’t done so already! We will continue posting weekly updates about We Were Here Too and the development of the game.
